intent: Establish the four-layer documentation system on the harness itself: a generated component catalog, pointer and staleness gates, and the binding charter.

requirements.REQ-DOC-A: A generated, revision-stamped component catalog renders modules, public names, dependency edges, tickets and acceptance coverage from the repository state without model calls.
requirements.REQ-DOC-B: The check fails when the committed generated catalog no longer matches a fresh render of the current tree.
requirements.REQ-DOC-C: The check fails when a hand-written documentation file references a repository path that does not exist in the working tree.
requirements.REQ-DOC-D: Advisory statistics report sentence overlap between hand-written documentation and the generated catalog, plus comment density and non-referential comment counts per module.
